```{r setup}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(htmltools)
library(knitr)
library(gt)

summary <- read_tsv("run_summary.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
review <- read_tsv("tables/samples_requiring_review.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)

metadata <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Run date", "Host", "Pipeline version"),
  Value = c(
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    paste(unique(summary$host), collapse = ", "),
    "1.0.0"
  )
)
```

## Overview

```{r}
overview_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Samples", "Complete", "Near-complete", "Partial", "Failed"),
  Count = c(
    nrow(summary),
    sum(summary$genome_status == "Complete"),
    sum(summary$genome_status == "Near-complete"),
    sum(summary$genome_status == "Partial"),
    sum(summary$genome_status == "Failed")
  ),
  Percent = c(
    1,
    sum(summary$genome_status == "Complete") / nrow(summary),
    sum(summary$genome_status == "Near-complete") / nrow(summary),
    sum(summary$genome_status == "Partial") / nrow(summary),
    sum(summary$genome_status == "Failed") / nrow(summary)
  )
)

overview_tbl |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Run Overview",
    subtitle = "Genome completeness across all samples"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    Metric = "",
    Count = "Count",
    Percent = "Percent"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = Count,
    decimals = 0
  ) |>
  fmt_percent(
    columns = Percent,
    decimals = 0
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#E9F5EB"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = Metric == "Complete")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#FFF3D6"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = Metric == "Near-complete")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#FDE8DD"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = Metric == "Partial")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#F9D9DE"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = Metric == "Failed")
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    table.font.size = px(14),
    heading.background.color = "#8C1D40",
    heading.title.font.size = px(18)
  )

### Run Metadata

## Sample Summary

```{r}
sample_table <-
  summary %>%
  mutate(
    QC = genome_status,
    Review = if_else(
      review_required,
      "⚠ Review",
      "✓ OK"
    ),
    Report = sprintf(
  '<a href="../summary/%s.sample_summary.md" target="_blank">📄 Report</a>',
  sample_id
)
  ) %>%
  select(
    sample_id,
    QC,
    Review,
    host,
    potential_subtype,
    ha_call,
    na_call,
    pass_segments,
    subtype_min_median_depth,
    aa_changes,
    synonymous_changes,
    nonsynonymous_changes,
    Report
  )

sample_table |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Sample Summary"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    sample_id = "Sample",
    QC = "QC Status",
    Review = "Review",
    host = "Host",
    potential_subtype = "Predicted Subtype",
    ha_call = "HA",
    na_call = "NA",
    pass_segments = "Passing Segments",
    subtype_min_median_depth = "Min Median Depth",
    aa_changes = "AA Changes",
    synonymous_changes = "Synonymous",
    nonsynonymous_changes = "Nonsynonymous",
    Report = "Sample Report"
  ) |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = Report) |>
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    table.font.size = px(13),
    heading.background.color = "#8C1D40",
    heading.title.font.size = px(18)
  )
```

## Genome Completeness

```{r}
asu_palette <- c(
  Complete = "#8C1D40",
  "Near-complete" = "#A95670FF",
  Partial = "#C58E9FFF",
  Failed = "#DFC9CFFF"
)

genome_status <-
  summary %>%
  count(genome_status) %>%
  mutate(
    genome_status = factor(
      genome_status,
      levels = c("Complete", "Near-complete", "Partial", "Failed")
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(
  genome_status,
  aes(
    genome_status,
    n,
    fill = genome_status
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = asu_palette) +
  labs(
    x = "Genome Status",
    y = "Samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p
```

## HA Subtype Distribution

```{r}
ha_counts <- summary %>%
  count(ha_call)

p <- ggplot(
  ha_counts,
  aes(
    x = reorder(ha_call, n),
    y = n
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "#8C1D40",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "HA Subtype",
    y = "Samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

p
```

## Average Coverage

```{r}

p
```

## Sequencing Depth Distribution

```{r}

  summary,
  aes(pass_segments)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    fill = "#FFC627",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:8) +
  labs(
    x = "Passing genome segments",
    y = "Samples"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

p
```
